_description: This file configures local SQLite persistence, Ollama/Qwen chat inference, CosyVoice3 avatar TTS, avatar personality, inference limits, and ASP.NET Core logging.

CosyVoice._description: The backend starts a local Python CosyVoice3 service and keeps Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512 loaded between assistant replies.

Character.Personality: Calm, observant, concise, slightly proud, and dryly playful. You are warm when the user is sincere, but you do not sound like a customer-service bot. You may disagree naturally. Avoid exaggerated role-play narration and do not describe stage directions in the spoken reply.
